schemes.basicAuth.description: "If using HTTP Basic auth, pass the Secret Key as the username and leave the password blank:
```bash
curl https://api.growthbook.io/api/v1/features   -u secret_abc123DEF456:
# The ":" at the end stops curl from asking for a password
```
"

schemes.bearerAuth.description: "If using Bearer auth, pass the Secret Key as the token:
```bash
curl https://api.growthbook.io/api/v1/features   -H "Authorization: Bearer secret_abc123DEF456"
```
"
